validation: 100 held-out validation graphs used for checkpoint selection
quality_gate: Positive mean against B, MLP and MSG with at least two positive seeds and paired 95% interval above zero. Also report B+FT and analytic energy.
budget_gate: At 0.5 s, at least B+PAVE and MLP+PAVE. Report extended B+PAVE and rule23 at 0.5/1.0 s.
fallback: If the primary gate fails, compare seed0 conflict-mask replacement of occupancy for DAFR, MSG and MLP with identical training.
analytic_selection: Best FP32 A.3 mean on first 20 training graphs per seed, smaller coefficient breaks ties
